text:
alex: Heads-up — PR #51299 touches KMS rotation middleware and a tiny NVLink scheduler tweak. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before I can queue the canary.

alex: Summary: change rotates an app-level wrapping key on parity interval and swaps a scheduling hint to reduce cross-GPU contention. No model-change.

alex: Diff: `pkg/kms/rotate.go` + `runtime/scheduler/nvlink_hint.cc` (30 LOC total). Tests: unit + small integration run in ci/short.

alex: Asking specifically for: @maya (runtime) for perf/regressions, @sam (infra) for CI/flakiness/merge gating, @ira (security) for key-audit + policy check.

maya: can you paste the perf numbers from your `perf-quick` run? want to see tail P95 on a 512 sequence.

alex: perf-quick results attached inline: "p50=18ms p95=83ms p99=160ms" vs baseline "p50=17ms p95=82ms p99=158ms" — within noise. Also ran 30m soak on a small pool, no mem growth.

sam: CI had a flaky `nvlink-smoke` test yesterday. did you hit that in your runs? if so we should either quarantine or rerun.

alex: I saw that flaky test fail locally once; I re-ran and it passed. I added a short retry in the job for `nvlink-smoke` in this PR (one-line). If infra prefers, we can revert and open follow-up to stable it.

ira: Security asks: ensure rotation is logged to audit with key-id and caller. also need an entry in the KMS policy doc describing rotation frequency and who can trigger. don't merge without that.

alex: good call — added `audit.LogKeyRotation(ctx, key)` call and a one-paragraph note in docs/kms-ops.md.

maya: quick nit: the scheduler hint change needs a comment explaining why NVLink ordering is changed — otherwise future devs will revert it. tiny request.

alex: added comment and link to `perf/notes/nvlink-ordering.md` (one-line explanation + perf bench command).

merge-bot: PR #51299 queued for cross-team review. Current status: CI=running, merge-window=auto.

sam: CI is green on my rerun. I can own infra approval once security signs off.

ira: I'll review the audit + policy snippet now. quick question — do you expose the rotation endpoint externally or is it internal-only?

alex: internal-only endpoint. auth via service identity and KMS roles. added that to the doc.

ira: OK — one small request: add a short test that asserts an audit event is emitted on rotation (can be a unit test that mocks audit). then I can sign off.

alex: added `rotate_test.go` with audit mock. test is small and fast.

maya: with the perf numbers and comments, I'm comfortable owning the runtime canary. I can take the canary tomorrow 10:00 PST.

sam: infra lgtm pending security sign-off.

ira: looked at the audit test and policy note — LGTM from security after the minor doc wording edit (pushed).

alex: thanks all — plan to schedule canary for 10:00 PST tomorrow and roll to prod if no regression in 2h. rollback plan: revert flag `nvlink_hint_v2` and rotate back key wrap to previous version (ops runbook updated).

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved: 2026-03-19 10:00 PST — slot reserved for alex/maya.

sam: I'll monitor infra during the canary. ping me if you want a live handoff.

maya: I'll watch perf dashboards and have 2 quick rollbacks ready. :thumbsup:

alex: awesome — thanks everyone. tagging this thread in PR #51299 for trace. :shipit:
